{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Group by patient_id and select the row with the maximum sample_seq
deduplicated_df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(deduplicated_df)
print(num_patients)"}
